attempted_claim: For standard single-spin Bowen-York puncture data with conformal flatness, bare mass m_p=1, and spin parameter S in [0,2], the outermost axisymmetric MOTS Sigma_S enclosing the puncture exists for every S, and with A(S) its area and J(S) its Komar angular momentum one has D(S)=A(S)/(8pi|J(S)|)-1>=1/4, with the convention D(0)=+infinity at zero spin. The 1/4 floor is uniform over the whole interval.
claim_type: exact benchmark gap on a natural dataset family
decisive_failure: No converged puncture solution was achieved: PDE residuals stayed at 1e-2 to order unity with disagreeing ADM mass estimates at S=2, the area census covered only four spins with an area-integration bug, and outermost status plus the continuum floor over [0,2] remain unproven, so no auditable claim can be made.
